source: BLS dated Employment Situation archive pages via web retrieval
scope: 36 release dates Jan 2022-Dec 2024, reference months Dec 2021-Nov 2024
limits: The archived page may have been corrected after original posting; original bytes and actual first-publication times are not authenticated.
This ledger extracts only the headline current-month payroll change and unemployment rate. It does not yet include revisions, wages, hours, labor-force participation, or consensus.

rows.title: L195:     			  THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION -- DECEMBER 2021
rows.headline_paragraph: Total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 199,000 in December, and the unemployment rate declined to 3.9 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.
